name: record_consent
description: Saves the permissions the farmer gave in this call. Call it once, with what was asked.

reports.description: true if they allow saving their report; false if not. Omit if not asked

notifications.description: true if they want text alerts; false if not. Omit if not asked

followup_calls.description: true if they accept follow-up calls; false if not. Omit if not asked
